_meta.description: Tier 3: Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) rule engine. Six new schemas (CcmRule, CcmFinding, CcmSegregationMatrix, CcmUserFunctionAssignment, CcmBaseline, CcmAuditCommitteeReport). Every rule/finding/report carries an immutable audit trail (x-openregister-audit-trail per). The four-state finding triage workflow and the report approval gate are declarative (x-openregister-lifecycle) with the cross-field preconditions delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\CcmFindingGuard (ADR-031 exception path). Finding notifications + critical-finding auto-escalation are declarative (x-openregister-notifications). The three nightly materialisation jobs (baseline 23:30, SoD 23:15, async sweep 23:00) are declarative (x-openregister-scheduled-workflows). No PHP TimedJob classes. Rule DSL evaluation is the one imperative service (OCA\Shillinq\Service\CcmRuleEngine). A pure deterministic AST evaluator with no eval/exec. Seed data ships the 60-rule forensic library across eight control families and a representative SoD function-code matrix. A contact/user is a Nextcloud entity. Rule owners, assignees, approvers are NC user ids (FK to the NC user directory), never an invented person schema. Extensions to journal-entry / journal-entry-line / organisations are DEFERRED to the bookkeeping-journal-entries / bookkeeping-general-ledger / organisations dependency apps (those schemas are not yet present in shillinq). See tasks.md.

CcmRule.title: CCM Rule
CcmRule.description: A Continuous Controls Monitoring rule definition. Carries the control family, objective, COSO assertion, severity, evaluation mode, trigger events, and the constrained JSON DSL logic (ruleLogic) evaluated by CcmRuleEngine. Parameters are tenant-configurable thresholds; ruleLogic is never arbitrary code. rule owner/reviewer are Nextcloud user ids (FK to the NC user directory). Immutable audit trail.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM Rule is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

ruleLogic.description: Constrained JSON DSL expression evaluated by CcmRuleEngine. Operators: event-matches / field-equals / field-in-set / field-greater-than / field-between / field-matches-regex / time-is-within / time-is-weekend / time-is-outside-business-hours / user-has-function / user-also-has-function / user-is-in-role / value-deviates-from-baseline / value-violates-benford / count-of-similar-in-period-exceeds / duplicate-of-existing / master-data-changed-within / approval-chain-bypassed / posted-while-period-closing / same-user-as; compound: all-of / any-of / none-of. Never arbitrary code: no eval.

CcmFinding.title: CCM Finding
CcmFinding.description: A single rule firing. Captures an immutable evidence snapshot at fire time (before/after, actor, approver chain, GL context) and transitions through a four-state triage workflow via x-openregister-lifecycle. Investigation notes and status history are append-only. Resolution requires a mandatory rationale (CcmFindingGuard). The assignee is a Nextcloud user id. Immutable audit trail.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM Finding is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

CcmSegregationMatrix.title: CCM Segregation Matrix
CcmSegregationMatrix.description: Segregation-of-duties reference data. One row per function code, listing the conflicting function codes a single user may not also hold, with conflict severity, rationale (Dutch), and the compensating controls allowed. Pre-loaded with the standard SAP/Oracle function library, tenant-configurable.

CcmBaseline.title: CCM Baseline
CcmBaseline.description: A statistical baseline that anomalous-amount and Benford's-Law rules compare against. Materialised nightly (not computed per evaluation) by the ccm-baseline-materialisation scheduled workflow over a rolling window per scope. stable=false when the sample size or variance is too small to flag.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM Baseline is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

ccm-baseline-materialisation.name: Baseline materialisation
ccm-baseline-materialisation.description: Nightly job (23:30) computing mean/median/stddev/Benford/typical-hour/typical-day baselines per scope over a rolling 12-month window. Completion SLA ≤1h. No PHP TimedJob: declarative scheduled workflow.

CcmAuditCommitteeReport.title: CCM Audit Committee Report
CcmAuditCommitteeReport.description: The period-end audit-committee deliverable. Assembles rule-firings by family/severity, findings by status, top findings, trend analysis, SoD compliance scorecard, manual-JE summary, approver-bypass summary, and (when SOX mode is enabled) the SOX 404 deficiency log. The executive summary is LLM-drafted then human-edited; no report is published without approver sign-off (CcmFindingGuard:canApproveReport). Immutable audit trail.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a CCM Audit Committee Report is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
